ledger.claim: The driver's own GPS trace never places him inside the arrival geofence at all. The derived arrival block records 0 qualifying in-geofence fixes out of 67 driver fixes, and the closest the driver's device ever came to the Blk 185 pickup pin was 134.62 m (derived.driver_track.min_distance_m = 134.62274443601794, derived.driver_track.max_distance_m = 302.37802988707597). For a STANDARD pickup zone the POL-NS-02 arrival radius is 50 m and the accuracy filter is 25 m. Limb (b) of POL-NS-01 therefore fails: the trace does not place the driver inside the pickup geofence at or before the recorded 'arrived' event at 09:44:52.

Because the trace contains no qualifying in-radius fix at any point in the 15 minutes preceding the 09:51:50 cancellation, POL-NS-02 deems the driver never to have ARRIVED and entitles the rider to a full refund of the cancellation fee. The zone class is STANDARD on the trip record, not LARGE_VENUE or TRANSPORT_HUB, so the radius is 50 m and not 120 m or 150 m.

Independently, POL-NS-01 limb (d) fails. The trip was terminated by the RIDER (cancelled_by = RIDER, status = CANCELLED_BY_RIDER) with cancellation_reason_code WRONG_PICKUP_LOCATION. Limb (d) requires the trip to be terminated by the DRIVER with one of RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT; none of the three is recorded. Two of the four conjunctive limbs of POL-NS-01 (limbs (b) and (d)) fail, and the anchor clause fails if any single limb breaks, so the SGD 4.00 fee is not chargeable under it.

On the dwell limb, the effective in-geofence dwell is 0 seconds (derived.arrival.longest_qualifying_run.duration_sec = 0.0, derived.arrival.qualifying_fix_count = 0) against the 300 second STANDARD minimum under fee_schedule.minimum_dwell_sec and POL-NS-01 limb (c) - a shortfall of 300 seconds (derived.arrival.shortfall_sec = 300.0). POL-NS-06 therefore refunds the cancellation fee in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she responded to messages.

Whether the driver was fully stationary or creeping, the whole 67-fix trace sits between 134.62 m and 302.38 m from the pickup pin - outside the 50 m POL-NS-02 arrival radius but comfortably inside the 400 m ceiling - and the driver's own statement puts him '200 m away' with a trace mean of 205.90 m. On any view the driver did not arrive at the pickup point, so POL-NS-03 governs and the cancellation fee is refunded to the rider in full.

Fault allocation under POL-NS-03 limb (i) runs against the driver, so no driver compensation is payable. The rider named the exact sub-location in the chat - 'my dad cannot walk, pls come to the block pickup bay Blk 185' at 09:45:50 - and the driver answered 'cannot' at 09:46:20 without moving to the block bay before cancelling at 09:51:50. Where the rider states the correct block in the chat log and the driver does not move to it, the driver bears the loss.

The rider was at the pin throughout. The rider_track in EV-GPS-00604 places her device within 11.97 m of the pickup pin on all 48 of her fixes (min 2.25 m, mean 7.44 m, 48 of 48 qualifying), far inside the 100 m STANDARD presence radius. Nothing about the rider's position can help the driver, and POL-NS-06 refunds on the dwell shortfall regardless of presence. I do not put this forward as a POL-NS-04 exoneration: the driver did post a chat reply within 120 seconds of the rider's message (09:45:50 to 09:46:20), so limb (b) of POL-NS-04 is not satisfied and that clause is not the route to the refund.

POL-NS-06 limb (i) cannot rescue the driver either, and I address it so the arithmetic stays closed. Limb (i) only permits separate in-geofence intervals to be summed; the trace shows 0 in-geofence intervals, 0 runs and 0.0 accumulated seconds within the 300 m leash, so there is nothing to accumulate and the 300 second shortfall stands. I also note, and disclose under POL-GEN-02, that the traffic advisory artifact EV-ADVIS-00604-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT); I rely on its absence only as citable absence, not as evidence of anything, and limb (i) requires a present and populated advisory of type KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT, which does not exist here.

No POL-NS-08 impairment applies to any fact this case turns on. The arrival event at 09:44:52 sits within the 10 s GPS cadence (max_gap_sec 0.0, point_count 67, coverage_pct 100.0, no gaps); the chat log holds 3 messages and is not truncated, matching trip_record.chat_message_count 3 with no msg_id gap and no gap spanning the arrival marker; and the SGD 4.00 cancellation line equals the fee_schedule.resolution_rule figure for this trip (GREATER of the STANDARD zone-class fee 4.00 and the RYDE_X tier fee 4.00), so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect. All four fact-carrying artifacts are COMPLETE at weight 1.0, so POL-NS-09 escalation is not engaged and the disposition is a full refund, not a partial one.

Nothing in either profile supports escalation or an adverse finding. driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, so the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check (4 or more AND a rate above 0.08) does not trip; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 and both parties' disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0, so POL-NS-09(c) and (d) are not engaged. Ratings, account age, lifetime trips and the lifetime counters prior_no_show_flags and prior_deviation_flags are context only under POL-GEN-01 and may not ground a finding on this trip.

ledger.claim: The correct disposition under POL-GEN-03 is FULL_REFUND for the filing party, who is the rider. The present state is payment_status CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00 and cancellation_fee 4.00, so NO_ACTION would leave a charge on her card that POL-NS-02, POL-NS-03 and POL-NS-06 do not support. No driver compensation attaches: POL-NS-03(i) allocates the loss to the driver, and POL-NS-06 pays none where the dwell falls short. amount_sgd is SGD 4.00 and driver_compensation_sgd is null.

The rider's own chat log defeats any exoneration under POL-NS-04. MSG-00604-002, her coordinating message naming the block ('my dad cannot walk, pls come to the block pickup bay Blk 185'), was sent at 09:45:50, and the driver answered at 09:46:20 - thirty seconds later, well inside the 120 second window POL-NS-04(b) allows. The clause says in terms that where the driver did reply within 120 seconds it does not apply 'regardless of the content of the reply', so limb (b) fails on the face of the log and the rider cannot claim the no-compensation exoneration that route offers her.

The arrival marker is not a false marker caught by POL-NS-05. Across the entire 67-fix trace the driver's recorded speeds are either 0 km/h or between 4.9 and 8.1 km/h, so the 15 km/h motion trigger is unreachable on this evidence, and his displacement from the pin never leaves the 134.6 m to 302.4 m band - he was in the vicinity of the pickup throughout, with stationary fixes. This is precisely the case POL-NS-05 carves out and sends to POL-NS-03 (a driver outside the arrival radius but nearby when he marks arrival), and the false-arrival entry that POL-NS-05(ii) would write into the referrals list is not available against him.

What the trace shows on the ground is a driver who was at the pickup venue but at the wrong face of it, which is the situation POL-NS-03 governs. Sixty-seven fixes with no sampling gap across eleven minutes place him with a nearest approach of 134.6 m and a mean displacement of 205.9 m from the pin - wholly inside POL-NS-03's 400 m ceiling - and that is corroborated by his contemporaneous account that the block road is narrow and blocked by delivery bikes so he stopped at the nearest safe place.

The physical record corroborates the driver's account rather than the hardship narrative: 0.56 km of travel in eleven minutes with every non-zero fix at 4.9 to 8.1 km/h is a carriageway the driver was crawling along, not a driver who declined to attend, and it explains why he never got inside the 50 m geofence before the rider cancelled at 09:51:50. A driver standing off 200 m on a block road he cannot enter is the POL-NS-03 wrong-entrance case, not a fee-farming no-show.

Fault under POL-NS-03 is allocated out of the chat log, and that log holds three civil messages - 'come to main road' at 09:45:10, the rider's request at 09:45:50, and the driver's 'cannot' at 09:46:20 - and nothing in it supports the rider's assertion that the driver 'got rude'. The driver's last word is a plain refusal on grounds of access, and the record does not contain a single abusive or gratuitous message from him.

The driver does not argue that the distance test can be carried: the trace's qualified in-geofence fix count is 0 and his closest fix is 134.6 m from the pin, beyond the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, so POL-NS-01 limb (b) is not made out on this evidence and the fee cannot stand on POL-NS-01. What the record does carry is limb (a), a driver 'arrived' event at 09:44:52, so the case is a wrong-face-of-the-pickup case under POL-NS-03 and not a driver who never attended the venue at all - and POL-NS-02's own 400 m sentence is what routes it there.

Nothing in either profile supports escalation, and nothing supports treating this driver as a fee-farmer: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1 against completed_trips_30d of 110, a ratio of 0.009, so neither limb of the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check is met; disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0 on both profiles and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, so POL-NS-09(c) and POL-NS-09(d) are not engaged. The case should be decided on the record, not referred, and the driver should not leave it carrying a false-arrival or farming marking.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee charged on TRP-00604 is refunded in full to the rider.

The driver's GPS trace (EV-GPS-00604, weight 1.0) contains 0 qualifying in-geofence fixes out of 67 fixes; the closest the driver's device came to the Blk 185 pickup pin was 134.62 m and the furthest 302.38 m, against a 50 m STANDARD arrival radius and a 25 m accuracy filter. POL-NS-01 limb (b) therefore fails. Limb (d) also fails: the trip record (EV-TRIP-00604, weight 1.0) shows cancelled_by RIDER with cancellation_reason_code WRONG_PICKUP_LOCATION, not a driver termination on RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT. The anchor clause fails if any single limb breaks, so the SGD 4.00 fee is not chargeable under it. Effective in-geofence dwell was 0 seconds against the 300-second STANDARD minimum (shortfall 300 s), so POL-NS-06 refunds the fee in full; under POL-NS-02 the driver is deemed never to have arrived, and the whole trace sits inside the 400 m ceiling (134.62 m to 302.38 m), which routes the case to POL-NS-03, where the outcome is likewise a full refund of the fee.

Driver compensation is nil. POL-NS-03 allocates fault from the chat log (EV-CHAT-00604, weight 1.0). The rider named the exact sub-location — 'my dad cannot walk, pls come to the block pickup bay Blk 185' at 09:45:50 — and the driver replied 'cannot' at 09:46:20 without moving to that bay before the 09:51:50 cancellation. Under POL-NS-03(i) the driver bears the loss. POL-NS-07 pays nothing because POL-NS-01 is not satisfied in full, and POL-NS-06 pays nothing where the dwell falls short. The driver's account that he stopped 200 m away is corroborated by the trace (mean displacement 205.90 m) but does not change the result, because the rider had told him where the block bay was.

On the driver's points: the 09:46:20 reply does defeat any POL-NS-04 exoneration for the rider (limb (b) fails, since the reply came within 120 seconds), but that clause is not the route to this refund, so it does not affect the outcome. The driver's recorded speeds never reach the 15 km/h POL-NS-05 motion trigger and the arrival marker is not shown to be more than 300 m from the pin at the arrival timestamp, so no false-arrival record is written and no referral issues. The chat log contains no abusive message from the driver — the rider's 'got rude' assertion is not supported by the log — but rudeness was never the test for this charge.

No POL-NS-08 impairment touches any fact this case turns on: the GPS trace has a max gap of 0.0 s at 100% coverage, the chat log's 3 messages match the trip record's chat_message_count of 3 with no msg_id gap, and the SGD 4.00 cancellation line equals the greater of the STANDARD zone-class fee (4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (4.00). No POL-NS-09 trigger fires: the anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d 1 against 110 completed trips in 30 days), and both parties' disputes_with_counterparty_90d and the rider's no_show_disputes_30d are 0. Ratings, account age, lifetime trips and the lifetime counters prior_no_show_flags and prior_deviation_flags are context only under POL-GEN-01 and ground nothing here. Confidence 0.95, capped by the weight-1.0 artifacts that carry the deciding facts.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
